lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense arrangement of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into approximately parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits, with the highest concentration of distinct local maxima located in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid appearance where the high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient exhibiting high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower-intensity values/shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (likely commensal fish) are visible in the ventral water column, one positioned near the base of the pectoral fin and another posterior to the branchial region.
